summary: Unexpected elevated 5xx error floor following orphaned-stream reclamation run
description: Issue summary: Customer MementoAI began reporting higher error rates and request failures at ~2026-03-12T20:18Z. Observed a sustained 5xx error floor that did not decay after the initial surge. Impact: multiple production tenants experienced elevated 502/503/504 responses, streaming sessions aborted. MementoAI reported failed inference requests and latency spikes; some long-running streams failed to resume. Environment: prod cluster in us-east; dedicated capacity for MementoAI. Steps to reproduce: 1) Run a high-concurrency streaming workload pinned to redwood-v2-large with long-lived sessions. 2) Trigger the orchestrated orphaned-stream reclamation job (scheduled cleanup of half-closed streaming handles). 3) Observe elevated 502/503 responses from api-gateway and runtime restarts within 5-15 minutes. Logs/metrics: api-gateway 5xx rate rose from baseline 0.2% to ~7.8% for tenant traffic; incoming connection resets and keepalive truncations spiked. Serving-runtime telemetry shows increased process OOMs and watchdog restarts correlated with reclaimer window. KV-cache eviction rate doubled and prefetch latency increased.
comments: Maya Chen (2026-03-12T21:03Z): Initial customer report forwarded to SRE. Shared sampling logs and top-line metrics with customer. Escalated to P1 due to dedicated contract and ongoing impact.

Arjun Patel (2026-03-12T21:30Z): Began correlation between reclaimer job execution window and onset of 5xx spike. Observed coincident SYN/FIN storms in edge proxy logs. Kicked off reproduction on staging; requested SRE to hold reclaimer schedule.

SRE Oncall (Lena Ortiz) (2026-03-12T22:05Z): Temporarily disabled orphaned-stream reclaimer in us-east to stop further disturbance. Noted immediate drop in new 502s but existing elevated floor persisted on some nodes. Collecting kernel and runtime crash dumps.
MementoAI (Support rep) (2026-03-12T22:40Z): Confirmed visible improvement for new requests after reclaimer pause but reported intermittent failures on previously long-running sessions.

Arjun Patel (2026-03-13T03:12Z): Posted early hypothesis: reclaimer triggered rapid connection teardown which caused a thundering reconnect pattern that overwhelmed idle/ephemeral worker pools and caused runtime OOMs via aggressive prefetch activity.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12T20:18Z: Surge start aligns with scheduled reclaimer job (window 20:15-20:25).
Edge proxy (apigw) logs show large numbers of FIN followed by immediate new SYNs from same client IP ranges, indicating reconnect loops rather than graceful drains.

Serving runtime pods show increased RSS growth and sporadic OOM kills during the reclamation window. Post-mortem snapshots show large KV cache churn and many prefetch workers waking and loading model weights simultaneously.
Autoscaler did not add capacity quickly enough because worker creation rate was throttled by ephemeral port exhaustion on a subset of nodes.

Hypothesis refined: reclaimer forced abrupt termination of half-closed streaming connections. Clients attempted immediate reconnects; prefix cache warmup + prefetch on reconnect produced memory amplification and transient OOMs, which cascaded into more reconnects and 5xx wave.
Cross-refs: SUP-472901 (connection-thrashing causing intermittent bridge 502s) shares similar signatures; relevant fixes there for keepalive tuning might apply.
Confirmed customer-specific config: MementoAI uses long keepalive timeouts and aggressive client-side reconnect logic which amplified the effect.
timeline: 2026-03-12T20:18Z - api-gateway 5xx rate begins to climb for MementoAI tenant.
2026-03-12T21:00Z - Support escalates to SRE and disables reclaimer job in us-east.
2026-03-12T21:10Z - Immediate reduction in new 502s, but node-level elevated 5xx floor persists.
2026-03-12T23:00Z - SRE collects runtime core dumps and NVMe metrics from affected hosts.
actions_taken: Disabled orphaned-stream reclaimer in us-east to stop further coordinated shutdowns.
Added temporary ingress keepalive allowance to reduce immediate reconnect storms (edge config patch: allow 5s drain window).
Scoped rollout of patch to throttle prefetch worker spin-up when reconnect rates exceed threshold (patch 1459 in PR).
Provisioned three additional ephemeral workers in affected nodepool to relieve autoscaler lag while diagnostics continue.
resolution: Workaround applied: reclaimer disabled and edge keepalive drain window extended. Patch to throttle prefetch spin-up merged to mainline (see PR) and scheduled for canary rollout. Customer MementoAI reported reduction in new errors; final resolution pending targeted canary and a follow-up run of reclaimer with safe-throttle flags. Post-incident action items documented in Confluence.
follow_up_tasks: Schedule controlled reclaimer run with throttling flags in a canary subset (ops task).
Add new alert for reconnect loop rates that trigger inhibition of prefetch worker creation.
Update reclaimer playbook to include prefetch backoff and to coordinate with autoscaler (confluence update).
Eng with MementoAI to recommend client-side backoff and staggered reconnects for long-lived streaming sessions.
Perform a postmortem with timeline, root cause, and code-level remediation (owner: Arjun Patel).
